interaction.prompt: You have the puck just inside the zone. Tap the teammate who has time and space to receive.

feedback.right: The LW up top has open ice — no defender within reach. That's time and space: room to receive, control, and make the next decision.
feedback.wrong: The RW looks available, but there's a defender right on their hip. Even if the pass gets there, the receiver has no time or space to do anything with it.

tip: Before you pass, scan both sides: who has a defender close by, and who has open ice? Pass to the player with space — not just the nearest teammate.
why: Time and space means the receiver has both the moment to catch the puck AND room to decide what's next. A covered teammate has neither — the read collapses before it starts.
